---
name: structured-delivery-mini
description: Produce a host-declared structured research artifact and submit it only after schema, completeness, and privacy validation.
---

# Structured delivery

1. Construct only the required schema fields and preserve their declared
   identifiers and types.
2. Verify every required field is non-empty, finite where applicable, and
   traceable to an approved artifact or evidence source.
3. Run the independent delivery validator before submission.
4. Do not add hidden reasoning, credentials, raw protected information, or
   invented evidence to satisfy a schema.
